crm-health-fitness.name: CRM Health Fitness
crm-health-fitness.shortDescription: Complete CRM for client management in the fitness industry.
crm-health-fitness.fullDescription: CRM system developed for comprehensive client management in gyms and personal training centers. Includes dashboard with metrics, client tracking, performance analytics and training plan management.

trainhub.name: TrainHub
trainhub.shortDescription: All-in-one platform for personal trainers: client management, routines and payments.
trainhub.fullDescription: SaaS for personal trainers with a visual routine builder, nutrition plans, real-time progress tracking, integrated chat and automatic billing via Stripe. Clients access everything through a PWA on any device.

wellnessreal.name: WellnessReal
wellnessreal.fullDescription: Professional fitness platform with personalized plans, nutrition and osteopathy. Mobile app with videos, progress tracking and weekly adjustments.

amuzim.name: Amuzim
amuzim.shortDescription: A music ecosystem for creators and listeners.
amuzim.fullDescription: A platform where creators decide what they share, with whom and why. Discovery across genres and subgenres, editorial, community and career-building tools for artists. I own the architecture, the stack and core engineering decisions.

codeconnect.name: CodeConnect
codeconnect.fullDescription: Next.js + TypeScript project for a startup. Clean UI, modular sections, process automation explained and contact form via Nodemailer.

dr-nutricion.name: DR Nutrición
dr-nutricion.fullDescription: Professional website for a clinical nutrition and digestive pathology specialist. Personalized follow-up plans, specialties, patient testimonials and direct contact system.

antea-salud.name: Antea Salud
antea-salud.shortDescription: In-home training and rehabilitation for seniors.
antea-salud.fullDescription: Professional landing for a gerontology and in-home physical rehabilitation service. Human-centered approach with testimonials, plan comparison and guided contact form.

caniches-con-amor.name: Caniches con Amor
caniches-con-amor.shortDescription: Consulting and community for poodle lovers.
caniches-con-amor.fullDescription: Website for a specialized poodle advisor. Consulting services, responsible breeding info, premium community and trusted breeder connections.

escapa-cantabria.name: Escapa Cantabria
escapa-cantabria.fullDescription: Website showcasing fleet, prices and reservations. Clean layout with mobile-friendly navigation.
